elaine: Quick heads-up — I found a gap in the private install guide around post-install networking for HSM over a hybrid VPN (Windows target). I opened a draft PR with a sample tunnel+ntp snippet and a short troubleshooting checklist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789 :mag:

samir: Thanks — can you paste the exact commands you're proposing? also which pages need the anchor/link fix?

chris: Paste below — tested this on Win Server 2019 with a fronting Linux bastion. TL;DR: use a persistent ssh tunnel for TCP proxying + explicit MTU/keepalive settings. Example PowerShell service wrapper and linux iptables side: 

```powershell
# on windows host (target)
$serviceName = "redwood-hsm-proxy"
$cmd = 'C:\\Program Files\\Git\\usr\\bin\\ssh.exe -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -R 15000:localhost:15000 bastion@bastion.example.internal'
New-Service -Name $serviceName -BinaryPathName $cmd -Description "Persistent SSH reverse tunnel to bastion for HSM traffic" -StartupType Automatic
Start-Service $serviceName
```

```bash
# on bastion (linux)
# accept reverse tunnel and forward to HSM subnet, adjust mtu if you see fragmentation
iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 15000 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.2.5.12:15000
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
# if MTU issues: ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400
```

chris: Also added note about forcing `-o ServerAliveInterval=30` and `-o TCPKeepAlive=yes` for long-lived tunnels.

docs-bot: PR 4789 created by elaine -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789 :white_check_mark: CI: docs-sanity, linkcheck queued.

marco: Nice. A couple of UX notes: 1) call out that customers using HSM with stricter firewall rules may need to open ephemeral ports between bastion and HSM; 2) include an alternate example using socat if ssh isn't allowed.

audrey: I noticed some pages rename earlier this month changed anchors under /private/vpc/install. We should update the internal anchor in the installer checklist page so the new cross-link in this PR doesn't 404. I'll list the broken anchors in the PR comments.

samir: Can we also include a short Windows troubleshooting table? e.g., common error strings from the HSM PKCS11 driver, plus a check for Windows Firewall blocking the ssh.exe service. Even 3 rows would help.

elaine: Yep — I'll add a small table under "Post-install checks" and a note: "If you see PKCS11 connection refused, validate MTU and proxy reachability, then check HSM admin logs."

marco: For the socat example: `socat TCP-LISTEN:15000,fork TCP:10.2.5.12:15000` on bastion, with systemd unit shown. Keep it short; link to the socat manpage.

audrey: I ran linkcheck locally and found two stale anchors: `/private/vpc/install#pakcs11` (typo) and `/private/vpc/install#ntp-sync`. I'll add a small patch to rename `#pakcs11` -> `#pkcs11` and re-run.

chris: One more edge-case: If customer uses IPsec with MSS clamping, the tunnel MTU can still be too big; recommend adding example `ip route change` to clamp MSS on the forwarded interface. I'll drop that in the PR.
